args.body:
Decision needed before I merge any customers. Merges move all orders and invoices to the surviving record and cannot be undone. “Clean them up” is not specific enough to authorize that.

I found 85 likely duplicate pairs (duplicates_2026-10-21.csv):

1. 73 pairs match on name, address, and tax ID (example: C-1001/C-1440 “Pellham Industrial”). Recommendation: merge these, keeping the lower ID in each pair, unless you want a different survivor rule.

2. 12 pairs match on name and address but have different tax IDs, so they may be separate legal entities (example: C-2210/C-2875 “Ridgeview Holdings”, tax IDs 41-0091822 / 41-0091950). Recommendation: do not merge these.

Please confirm whether to proceed with the 73 same-tax-ID merges, and the survivor rule. I will not merge the 12 different-tax-ID pairs unless you explicitly say so.
